title: CollectCmDiagnosticsRequest
description: Request object for collecting Datahub diagnostics.

destination.description: Destination of the diagnostics collection (Support, Own cloud storage, Engineering or collect only on the nodes)

description.description: Additional information / title for the diagnostics collection.

caseNumber.description: Optional support case number in case of SUPPORT destination, otherwise only act as additional data.

roles.description: Array of roles for which to get logs and metrics. If set, this restricts the roles for log and metrics collection.

startDate.description: Restrict collected logs and metrics (from the provided date timestamp).

endDate.description: Restrict collected logs and metrics (until the provided date timestamp).

updatePackage.description: If enabled, required package (cdp-telemetry) will be upgraded or installed on the nodes. (useful if package is not installed or needs to be upgraded) Network is required for this operation.

storageValidation.description: Enable/disable node level storage validation (can be disabled for example, if you have too many hosts and do not want to do too much parallel writes to s3/abfs)

monitorMetricsCollection.description: Flag to enable collection of metrics for chart display in CM based diagnostics collection.

bundleSizeLimit.description: Diagnostics bundle size limit in MB.
